### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Selects the corrected-PE face gravity work of @sec-ch06-dwork, whose budget quantity is the
corrected potential energy @eq-ch06-dwork-pe and whose booked increment is @eq-ch06-dwork-d.

**Data.** In: the stage's $x_1$ mass-flux divergence (the density change) and the grid's $x_1$ faces; out:
the face-work energy increment, and the matching term in the implicit operator.

**Placement.** In `HydroImpl::forward`, in the gravity-work bookkeeping after the fluxes; in the implicit
operator when a vertical implicit scheme runs.

**Activation.** `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT`, default on (an empty value is on too). It acts only when
`grav1` is nonzero, `gravity-work` is `face` (the YAML default) and the grid has an $x_1$ measure: Cartesian,
spherical-polar or gnomonic-equiangle.

**Guarantee / limits.** The discrete budget of energy plus corrected potential energy is exact up to round-off
and boundary fluxes; on a grid without an $x_1$ measure (cylindrical) the switch warns once and plain face work
runs; on a periodic $x_1$ column it warns once and the corrected potential is not single-valued.

**Evidence.** `test_gravity_work_radial_exact_python`: per-step relative change of $E+P$ at most $10^{-14}$ on
spherical-polar, Cartesian and gnomonic-equiangle columns, explicit and implicit, the printed budget to
$10^{-11}$, unset equal to `1` bit for bit ({{< code tests/test_gravity_work_radial_exact.py main >}});
`test_x1_seam_split_radial_exact.<b>`: a split column matches one block exactly with the switch on and to
$10^{-13}$ with it off ({{< code tests/test_x1_seam_split.cpp X1SeamSplit.radial_exact_split_gap >}}); check
`[C5]` of `configuration_check.py`; the ctests were not run at the pin.
:::

This section keeps the selector, the grid and work-mode gates and the registered arms of the corrected face
work; the derivation of the corrected potential energy, the centroid slope and the implicit row is in
@sec-ch06-dwork and is not repeated here.

### Derivation

See @sec-ch06-dwork for the corrected potential energy and the matching work. The chapter's check line `[C5]`
re-derives the cell-by-cell cancellation of the slope term for a fixed linear slope matrix
[check `src/snapy_report/ch12/configuration_check.py`, output
`src/snapy_report/ch12/configuration_check.out`].

### Numerical method

`HydroImpl::gravity_work_radial_exact` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::gravity_work_radial_exact >}})
reads the variable once; `HydroImpl::radial_exact_work` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::radial_exact_work >}})
adds the three run-time gates: nonzero `grav1`, `gravity-work` equal to `face`, and a grid whose `x1_measure`
({{< code src/hydro/gravity_work_radial.hpp x1_measure >}}) is not `none`, which holds for `cartesian`,
`spherical-polar` and `gnomonic-equiangle`. At setup `HydroImpl::reset` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}})
warns once when the switch is on with face work on a grid without a measure and once on a periodic $x_1$
column; neither warning changes the run. In `HydroImpl::forward` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}})
the corrected work replaces the curvature work of the `cp3`, `cp5` and `weno5` faces rather than adding to it,
books the increment with `corrected_pe_work` ({{< code src/hydro/gravity_work_radial.hpp corrected_pe_work >}})
on an unsplit column, and with `corrected_pe_work_seam`
({{< code src/hydro/gravity_work_radial.hpp corrected_pe_work_seam >}}) across an $x_1$ seam, where the
neighbour's density change is exchanged so that a seam cell takes the centred slope of one block; a periodic
$x_1$ column keeps the one-sided slope at its block edges. With `face-wallc` the $x_1$ wall cells keep the cell
work. An implicit scheme refuses an $x_1$ split, so the implicit row sees one block
(`HydroImpl::face_work_in_operator`, {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::face_work_in_operator >}}). The
YAML default `gravity-work: face` is set by `ConstGravityOptionsImpl::from_yaml`
({{< code src/forcing/const_gravity.cpp ConstGravityOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}).

: Implementation sites for the corrected-work selector. {#tbl-ch12-radial-exact-code}

1. Read the switch once; combine it with the gravity, work-mode and measure gates. The anchor
   `radial_exact_work` is in {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::radial_exact_work >}}.
2. At setup, warn once on a grid without a measure and on a periodic $x_1$ column. The anchor
   `TORCH_WARN_ONCE` is in {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}.
3. Book the corrected increment instead of the curvature work, with the seam form on a split column. The
   anchor `radial_exact` is in {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}.

The independent checks and their outputs are catalogued in @sec-ch15-ch12-tests.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
A grid without an $x_1$ measure keeps the first-order plain face work with only a warning. A lone
gnomonic-equiangle block with reflecting lateral walls is a mass-conservation question of the grid, not of this
switch (@sec-ch16). Split and unsplit $x_1$ columns agree except on a periodic $x_1$ column, whose seams keep
the one-sided slope.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
